_about: Lines on the subway map. The map shows your most active projects (max_lines), ranked by commits in the last active_days; when a newer project passes one, the weakest drops off. Projects with a film open under 'building now' right under the map; others are 'side projects'. Listed projects that drop off are shown faded under 'past projects' and still open their cards. Any PUBLIC repo you commit to can earn a line on its own; a PRIVATE repo only shows once its full name is in private_allow. Repos in hide never show; repos in ignore are never even fetched.
